parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1). It is both the plan lookup key AND the associate scope: activeHeads counts only assignments whose associate has an active (not-ended) shift at that site (ADR 0034, ADR 0035). The code is accepted as given, never validated against facility-layout.

parameters.name: shiftId
parameters.description: The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.
